source: Researcher-provided synthetic workflow test data: paired.csv; response in AU; no normalization or exclusions; six independent donors, each preparation split into control and treated with one measurement per condition and no technical replicates.

comparison.rationale: Researcher-prespecified two-sided paired t test of the mean within-donor difference treated minus control against zero. Six mutually independent donors; paired conditions share the same donor preparation; 95% Student-t confidence interval. No normalization, aggregation or exclusion.
